desc.en: Lan Xang's mines and workshops have taken a verifiable export order while local wages, employment and current law contradict one another; the Jinghai buyer waits at the other end for a term and a wage answer.

title.en: The Order Presses into the Workshops

desc.zh: 靖海订单附着自己的交期与验货章程。矿场和作坊要么摊派加产赶工，要么按现有工力分批接下；工价与雇工现状须先由澜沧自行核对。
desc.en: The order from Jinghai carries its own delivery term and inspection rules. The mines and workshops either press extra shifts to fill it or accept it in batches at existing strength; wages and employment must be audited by Lan Xang itself.

consequence_note.zh: 记录本次决定，交期交由买方提出。
consequence_note.en: Records this decision; the buyer sets the term.

label.en: Withdraw the export order and sell only locally

consequence_note.en: Records this decision.

purpose.en: The Order Presses into the Workshops

desc.zh: 靖海账房按订单规模提出交期：限期加验，或宽限并预付定金。订单也可以就此撤回。已付的定金不会在复议时再收一次。
desc.en: Jinghai's counting house proposes a term for the order: a short deadline with inspection, or a relaxed term with an advance. The order may also be withdrawn. An advance already paid is not collected twice on reconsideration.

consequence_note.en: The advance is filed, no transfer to Lan Xang; Lan Xang faces the wage dispute.

label.en: Withdraw the order for other arrangements

desc.zh: 矿场与作坊的雇工第一次联名呈递工价争议。结社权利越弱，联名越容易散去，也有人提议改行地方供役顶替外港订单。
desc.en: Employed miners and workshop hands submit their first joint petition over wages. The weaker the right of association, the more easily the petition disperses, and some propose substituting local corvée for the export order.

title.en: Rumors of Wages at the Outer Ports

desc.zh: 外港行情传到靖海：别处矿场与作坊给出的工价更高。买方要么承认工价加价采购，要么压价照旧，也可以另派估价人实地核定。
desc.en: News of the outer ports reaches Jinghai: mines and workshops elsewhere pay higher wages. The buyer may acknowledge the wage and raise the purchase price, hold the old price, or send an assessor to verify on site.

title.en: The Delivery Day After the Stoppage

desc.en: After the stoppage the delivery day still comes. Settling the wage arrears and delivering on time takes treasury funds; shipping as-is without settling is also possible; if the buyer is still reachable, the goods may be held for talks.

purpose.en: The Delivery Day After the Stoppage

desc.zh: 交货之后检查员进入作坊核对工场安全。现行法律越完备，整改越有依据；若买方已无法联系，澜沧可按已做的决定结案。已付的整改费用不会在复议时再收一次。
desc.en: After delivery the inspector enters the workshop to check workplace safety. The more complete the current law, the firmer the basis for rectification; if the buyer can no longer be reached, Lan Xang may close on the decisions it has already made. A paid rectification is not collected twice on reconsideration.
